In [[cosmology]], the '''critical density''' of the universe is the total [[cosmological fluid]] density $\rho_\text{total}$ corresponding to a spatially-flat [[Universe]] ([[spatial curvature parameter]] $k=0$) according to the [[1st Friedmann equation]].
